diagrams.name: String_Compare
diagrams.description:
Compares two String objects in a case-sensitive manner.

String data is treated as ascii.

Returns values:
-1: left < right
 0: left == right
 1: left > right

items.text:
public

const struct String* left  // The left string to compare. Not null.
const struct String* right // The right string to compare. Not null.

returns int // -1 <,  0 ==, 1 >.

All characters are equal in the
first parts of the strings.

At this point, the shorter string
will be considered 'less'.

diagrams.name: Memory_Allocate
diagrams.description:
Allocates a memory buffer big enough to hold the specified number of objects with the given size.

Never returns NULL. Calls abort() if allocation fails.

The returned memory region is filled with zeroes.

The program must use Memory_Free later on to deallocate the memory block returned by Memory_Allocate.

items.text:
public

int numOfObjects // The number of objects to allocate memory for. Must be positive.
int objectSize   // The size of each object in bytes. Must be positive.

returns void*    // Returns a pointer to the allocated buffer. Never returns NULL.

diagrams.name: Memory_Free

items.text:
public

void* buffer // Points to the memory region to free. Can be null.

diagrams.name: ObjectArray_Create
diagrams.description:
Creates a new instance of ObjectArray with the specified size.

If a non-null elementDestructor is provided during the array construction, the array receives ownership on its elements. Ownership means the array will destroy its elements when it itself is being destroyed.

items.text:
public

int size  // Number of elements in the created array. Non-negative.
ObjectDestructor elementDestructor // The destructor to call for each element when 
                                   // the array is destroyed. Can be null.

returns struct ObjectArray* // Returns the constructed object. Ownership. Not null.
